notes.subject: כי בא כי בא
notes.rationale: Doubled 'for he comes, for he comes' — repetition builds certainty; Bamanankan repeats 'sabu a nana' to keep the beat.

notes.subject: dugukolo min mɔgɔw bɛ
notes.rationale: תבל is the inhabited world, distinct from הארץ (dugukolo); rendered descriptively since Bamanankan has no single word for it.

notes.subject: nana
notes.rationale: בא perfect: 'he is come' (jps/ylt) vs 'he is coming' (bsb); Bamanankan 'a nana' keeps the perfective shape.

notes.subject: verse
notes.rationale: The verse completes the summons of vv.11-12: all creation rejoices before Yawe who comes to judge.

translation: Yawe ɲɛda fɛ, sabu a nana, sabu a nana ka dugukolo sariya-ɲɛnabɔ. A bɛna dugukolo min mɔgɔw bɛ ɲɛnabɔ ni sariya-ɲɛfɔli ye, ani jamaw ni a tiɲɛ ye.
